lifetime.verification: PRIMARY_ELF_VERIFIED for listed operations; validity rules STATIC_INFERRED
lifetime.assignment_operations: Checks receiver==source; decrements old counter, cleans on zero; increments source counter; shares container and counter pointers
lifetime.replacement: 0x7ededa rejects null incoming element; identical incoming/stored pointer returns 0; same key+discriminator deletes old element then removes slot
lifetime.borrowed_pointer_validity: STATIC_INFERRED: must retain initialized owning storage and avoid deleting/replacing that element; get does not extend lifetime
lifetime.copy_on_write: No detach in examined assignment/add/replacement path; mutation affects shared container. Other mutation APIs UNKNOWN
lifetime.atomicity: Counter updates are ordinary load/add-or-sub/store, no atomic instructions in examined bodies
lifetime.external_synchronization: UNKNOWN; no claim that all callers lack locking

firmware_safety_observations.lookup: get lacks null receiver/container/element guards; wrappers guard list/output only after reading wrapper+4
firmware_safety_observations.invalid_key: Valid collection with no matching pair returns null
firmware_safety_observations.counter_underflow: No zero-counter precondition check in examined decrement path
firmware_safety_observations.concurrent_access: Runtime caller locking and scheduler assumptions UNKNOWN
firmware_safety_observations.snapshot_parser_guards: Self-authored bounds, budget, null-element and type validation; these do NOT describe Sony firmware protections

limitations: Only PrmNumber and PrmBool payload semantics are verified; additional families remain layout-only
Discriminator alone does not prove type
RTTI follows single-inheritance record candidates; no complete class hierarchy claim
